definitions.gloss: careful selection; hand-picking; selecting the best
definitions.explanation: The act of carefully choosing only the best items from a larger group. Often used in product descriptions and book titles to emphasize quality curation.

examples.japanese: {精選|せいせん}された{素材|そざい}を{使|つか}う。
{全国|ぜんこく}から{精選|せいせん}した{食材|しょくざい}を{取|と}り{寄|よ}せている。
examples.english: We source hand-picked ingredients from across the country.

examples.japanese: この{問題集|もんだいしゅう}は{過去|かこ}の{入試|にゅうし}{問題|もんだい}を{精選|せいせん}して{収録|しゅうろく}したものだ。
examples.english: This workbook is a collection of carefully selected past entrance exam questions.

notes:
USAGE:
Often used as a する verb ({精選|せいせん}する) or in the passive past form ({精選|せいせん}された). Common in marketing, publishing, and product descriptions to emphasize quality over quantity.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {精選|せいせん}された〜 (carefully selected...)
- {精選|せいせん}する (to carefully select)
- 〜を{精選|せいせん}して (having carefully chosen...)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {厳選|げんせん}: strict selection — emphasizes even stricter standards of selection
- {選別|せんべつ}: sorting/screening — more neutral, focuses on the process of separating
